info.title: RayWn2App Station API
info.description: Version 1 read-only Station Host HTTPS/JSON contract. Default API port 47828; desktop and service listeners default OFF. Authentication grants device identities, not channel control. This is separate from WSS, MQTT and application release numbering.

parameters.description: 0 means all channels, 1–4 selects one RF channel.

parameters.description: Start at 0, then use the returned next cursor. Arbitrary offsets can fail with 409.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Start at 0 to capture a boundary, then preserve the returned end. A nonzero offset requires a nonzero end.

stationBearer.description: Send the exact Authorization: Bearer TOKEN header over verified TLS. Tokens are locally issued and revoked, never sent as URL/query parameters or cookies. No OAuth flows.

coupler.description: Configured coupler model; None means not configured.

profile.description: Configured calibration profile identity; not proof of physical qualification.

status.description: Human-readable measurement condition. Do not branch on exact wording.

power_status.description: Validity in forward average, reflected average, forward peak, reflected peak order.

forward_average_W.description: Forward average power in watts, or null if unusable.

reflected_average_W.description: Reflected average power in watts, or null if unusable.

forward_peak_W.description: Forward peak power in watts. Host measurement, not a client software-held peak.

reflected_peak_W.description: Reflected peak power in watts. Independent of forward peak.

swr.description: SWR ratio; null at Low RF, invalid data or nonfinite result.

return_loss_dB.description: Return loss in dB; null if invalid/nonfinite. Can be negative.

average_power.description: Optional provenance: policy (legacy or explicitly selected raw-usb-host-estimate), effective forward/reflected processing, and swr_basis (legacy-average or explicitly selected paired-peak). Watt readings are already processed; clients must not apply the estimate again. An active reference curve bypasses estimation for its direction. Other processing states identify the low-level gate or unavailable inputs. Firmware is not automatically inferred; modulated-signal accuracy remains unqualified.

swr_calculation.description: Optional SWR/return-loss provenance. Legacy average-power ratio is the default. Paired-peak uses calibrated forward/reflected peaks from the same USB acquisition frame, selecting the median-ratio pair from up to three valid frames within 1000 ms. This independent RF StateSide filter does not reproduce the vendor host algorithm. Invalid, low-RF or clipped input clears history. Peak measurements and software-held peaks are not modified. Same-frame grouping does not prove simultaneous hardware acquisition. No firmware capability is inferred. The chosen pair can predate the current frame; inspect age_ms and frame. Unknown optional fields must be tolerated.

age_ms.description: Age of selected pair at snapshot generation; -1 without a selected peak pair.

frame.description: Session telemetry frame count for the selected pair; 0 without a peak pair.

forward_W.description: Calibrated ratio-basis forward watts, null if stale or unavailable.

reflected_W.description: Calibrated ratio-basis reflected watts, null if stale or unavailable.

power_conversion.description: Optional per-device/channel/coupler calculation provenance. Legacy uses the saved scalar/reference profile unchanged. Explicit wavenode-host-v1 is a separate factory detector conversion for LP-1, standard HF and channel-specific HF-8KW families; saved scalar coefficients are bypassed but not modified, ADC zeros are retained. Active reference matching preserves the whole channel legacy conversion. Unsupported models remain on the stored profile. Per-frame only: no original-host display-history filtering or firmware inference. Physical RF accuracy is unqualified. Consumers must not apply this processing again. Eligible new supported coupler configurations select host factory conversion, corrected detector average and paired-peak SWR; existing saved policies retain their behavior. These preferences do not establish physical RF accuracy. All nine current couplers are mapped; L/M-1, CS-1, UHF-220MHz and UHF-70cm share the HF family by owner-approved rated-range mapping, identified in processing metadata and not independently physically qualified. Historical 8KW/HF-UHF keys are retained; 20KW factory parity is deferred.

trip.description: Recognized fresh relay status only; unknown remains unknown.

description.description: Advisory host protection description, not physical contact verification.

device.description: Exact granted device identity; do not use the toolbar selection as an identity.

transport.description: Host transport label, for example VCP, D2XX, Emulator or Replay.

source.description: Separates physical hardware from simulated/replay data.

fresh.description: Current host freshness flag. HTTP success does not imply this is true.

connected.description: Transport connection state; a connected device can have stale measurements.

state.description: Human-readable session state; do not parse exact wording.

age_ms.description: Host-observed sample age in milliseconds; -1 means no sample yet.

received_utc.description: Host receipt time of the latest sample, not the response time. Null before first sample.

frame.description: Decimal-string telemetry counter. It can restart with a new session; it is not a globally unique cursor.

unit.description: Configured display unit, for example V, A, °C or °F. Never assume every analog input is volts.

valid.description: Whether this configured input conversion is usable in this sample.

value.description: Configured value in unit, or null when invalid/stale. Zero is a value.
Configured logical state encoded as 0 or 1 including inversion; null when stale. API v1 does not serialize this field as a JSON boolean.

inputs.description: Analog 1–4, DC voltage and DC current.

schema.description: Payload schema version; independent of the application release.

server_utc.description: UTC timestamp generated by the host, in RFC 3339 format.

history_available.description: Whether a history directory is configured; not a guarantee of files or writable storage.

device_count.description: Currently configured devices within this token grant.

certificate_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the host TLS certificate.

devices.description: Configured devices visible to this token; never a grant to undisclosed devices.

columns.description: Ordered CSV column names. Row cells correspond to these names.

rows.description: CSV cells, all strings. Empty measurement cells mean unavailable, not zero.

next.description: Byte cursor for the next page. Always use the returned cursor, including for an empty filtered page.

end.description: Fixed segment byte boundary. Retain for the whole export.

more.description: Continue until false; rows can be empty while more is true.

error.description: Diagnostic string. May be a short code or human-readable history error. Exact wording is not a stable enum.

Error400.description: Malformed request, unsupported body, unknown/repeated/empty query parameter, invalid cursor or segment.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.

Error401.description: Missing, malformed, revoked or unrecognized bearer token.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.

Error403.description: Requested device is outside the token grant.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.

Error404.description: Unknown route or explicitly selected granted device is no longer configured.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.

Error405.description: Authenticated request uses a method other than GET.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.

Error409.description: History file unavailable, rotated, truncated or incompatible; refresh the segment list.

Cache-Control.description: Do not cache telemetry or errors.
